skills.name: Fire Missiles
skills.description:
X.Borg sprays fire in the target direction, dealing 25<font color='#D58E1F'>( +60% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#27C0C7'>(+40% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> 7 times over 2s to enemies in range (only deals 75% damage against Minions). Enemies at maximum temperature are dealt <font color='#E5CB19'>(True Damage)</font> instead.
<font color='#404495'>(Armorless)</font> State: The attack area becomes narrower but longer, while the damage is reduced to 60% of that in <font color='#404495'>(Armored)</font> state.
skills.tips: "X.Borg activates the flame thrower and fires in the designated direction, dealing physical damage over time. If  enemies' temperature rises to the limit they will take true damage and slow down. Armorless State: X.Borg adjusts the flamethrower to a narrower angle and longer distance with reduced damage.  This is X.Borg's main DPS skill, which is good at dealing sustained damage and increasing the chance to trigger his passive."

skills.name: Fire Stake
skills.description:
X.Borg shoots 5 Fire Stakes at the edge of the fan-shaped indicator and retrieves them after 1.7s, each dealing 50<font color='#D58E1F'>( +20% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> and pulling the enemies in the path toward him. Firaga Supplies in the path will also be retrieved if touched by Fire Stakes.
<font color='#404495'>(Armorless)</font> State: X.Borg adjusts Fire Stake Launcher to increase its range and shorten the distance between Fire Stakes.
skills.tips: X.Borg shoots several Fire Stakes at the edge of the fan-shaped indicator. After a few seconds, the stakes are taken back into his body. Each stake deals physical damage to enemies in its path and pulling them back. If the Fire Stake touches the Firaga supplies in its path, it pulls them back as well. Armorless State: X.Borg adjusts the Fire Stake Launcher to send the stakes a further distance and shortens the gap between the stakes.  The fire stakes can effectively stop enemies from escaping and can be used to pick up the Firaga supplies generated from X. Borg's Passive.

skills.name: Last Insanity
skills.description:
X.Borg charges in the target direction while rotating and spraying fire, dealing 200<font color='#D58E1F'>( +130% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#27C0C7'>(+90% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> 7 times and slowing enemies hit by 25%. He stops upon running into an enemy hero and will slow them by an additional 40%. After 3s from the start of the skill, X.Borg's <font color='#404495'>(Firaga Armor)</font> will detonate, dealing <font color='#E5CB19'>(True Damage)</font> to nearby enemies equal to 300 plus 15% of their Max HP. If the Armor is destroyed before it can self-detonate, it will only deal 50% of the damage. When his Armor detonates, X.Borg will dash a short distance in the Joystick's direction and enter the <font color='#404495'>(Armorless)</font> state while removing all debuffs from himself.
This skill cannot be used in the <font color='#404495'>(Armorless)</font> state.
<font color='#404495'>(Use Again)</font>: X.Borg stops spraying fire and immediately detonates his <font color='#404495'>(Firaga Armor)</font>.
skills.tips: X.Borg charges forward in a designated direction, shooting fire around to deal physical damage and slowing enemies down. If he hits an enemy hero during the charge, he will stop charging and slow the target. Then he self-explodes and deals true damage based on the target's max HP. The explosion destroys the current Firaga Armor and puts himself under armorless state. After exploding he returns to moving normally.   This powerful skill is designed for teamfights. The high damage can cause a davastating blow to enemeis. However, before using this skill you should pay attention to the long cast animation and the cost of losing all HP of the Firaga Armor.

skills.name: Firaga Armor
skills.description:
X.Borg's Firaga Armor inherits 120% of his Max HP and absorbs all incoming damage when it's active. When the Armor is destroyed, X.Borg will disengage from it and roll in the direction of the Joystick (he is immune to damage during this process). The Armor's energy will gradually regenerate while X.Borg is in the Armorless State. At full energy, X.Borg re-equips the Armor and restores it to 30% of his Max HP.
X.Borg's fire damage causes enemies to heat up. Enemies at maximum temperature will drop Firaga supplies when they take fire damage from X.Borg. Picking up a Firaga supply restores 10% of the Armor's HP, or 10 energy while in the Armorless State.
skills.tips: X.Borg is equipped with a homemade Firaga Armor that inherits a portion of his HP and takes all damage for X.Borg while it's active. A short circuit will take place when the armor runs out of HP, and X.Borg will do a roll to the direction of the Left Joystick to disengage from the armor. In this meantime, X.Borg won't take any damage. He then continues to restore energy in Armorless State. When energy is full, X.Borg will re-equip the armor and restore the armor. X.Borg's fire damage causes enemies to warm up, and enemies with ultra-temperature will drop Armor parts when they take flame damage. Pick up parts and restore Armor, or restore energy while in Armorless State.

items.name: Warrior Boots
items.des: Unique Passive - Valor: Gain 4 extra Physical Defense for 3s when taking Physical Damage, up to 20.

items.name: Immortality
items.des: Unique Passive - Immortal: Revives 2.5s after death, gaining 16% Max HP and a 220-1200 shield (scales with level) that lasts 3s (210s cooldown).

items.name: War Axe
items.des: Unique Passive - Fighting Spirit: Dealing damage grants 12 extra Physical Attack and 2% extra Spell Vamp per second for 4s, up to 6 stacks. Deal 10% extra True Damage according to Base Damage at full stacks.####[C8This effect is reduced to 50% for Marksmen, Mages, and Supports.]

items.name: Blade of Despair
items.des: Unique Passive - Despair: Dealing damage to non-Minion enemies below 50% HP increases Physical Attack by 25% for 2s (takes effect before the damage is dealt).

items.name: Oracle
items.des: Unique Passive - Bless: Received Shield and HP Regen effects are increased by 30%.

builds.tips: Since X.Borg is a great sustained damage dealer, we strongly recommend this set of Equipment. This set of equipment is very fit in with X.Borg's sustain dps ability and bursting true damage feature.
